expectations.text: Frames the decision as whether the next dollar of spend still makes money, not how much the account can spend.
expectations.evidence: Opens by rejecting blended MER as the wrong lens: "The number that matters here is what the *next dollar* of prospecting spend returns." Builds a marginal MER column ((140-122)/(48-40)=2.25, (152-140)/(56-48)=1.50) and notes 1.50 is already below the 2.0 break-even, so "August's last $8K of spend lost money." Extrapolates the decay to show the $24K jump lands in unprofitable increments, recommends a step to $64-65K rather than a spend-capacity-based answer, and closes by instructing the user to monitor marginal MER weekly and pull back when an increment drops under ~2.5-3.0 — decision criterio
